ACCOUNTS AND SAVED DATA

Your collection, with clear access conditions.

Public pages, including the card catalog, Pokédex, and Team tool, are available without an account. Managing a personal collection requires a signed-in account and an available sync service. Collection data is kept in this browser and synchronizes with your account when the service is available.

Lunidex is an independent, unofficial project.

title: Nuzlocke Tracker | Lunidex
main:
CHALLENGE MODE

Nuzlocke Tracker

A practical guide to the Nuzlocke tracker: runs, encounters, one catch per route, and status tracking — based on the features that actually exist in Lunidex.

Short answer

The Nuzlocke tracker records your challenge runs: create a run, add one encounter per route with the Pokémon you found, then follow each Pokémon status — alive, dead or boxed. A stats strip summarizes the run at a glance. In the current web runtime, run data uses the account-backed workspace; sign in to save and synchronize it.

The Nuzlocke page works in four steps: create a run, add encounters, update statuses, then review the statistics.
